featuresPage.title: Pagayo Features - Webshop, POS, WhatsApp and QR in one platform
featuresPage.description: Discover all Pagayo features for e-commerce and hospitality: order management, inventory, coupons, returns, subscriptions, analytics and omnichannel sales in one dashboard.
